B) deviates: the under-60s target for 10k rows is not needed this sprint

B) deviates: this sprint exports CSV without committing to the ticket’s 10k-row, under-60s requirement.
C) deferred: acme/widgets#77 - leave the timing requirement tracked on the ticket for a later sprint.
D) repair the ticket - /skill:shape-ticket acme/widgets#77 to revise the timing row based on your requested sprint scope.
